% PUBLIC ENTRY AND MODES
%   report = rebuild_iecon2026_opf_video(mode, output_folder, Name, Value, ...)
%   'check'   Recompute all 9,973 progressive rows and all 600 display cycles.
%             Compare arrays and metrics; do not render frames or encode video.
%   'preview' Recompute the same context and render ten selected reference
%             frames near lookup/limit crossings, the late ramp and endpoints.
%   'full'    Recompute all 600 cycles, render and inspect every frame, then
%             encode and fully decode the 20 s / 30 fps / 2560 x 1440 MP4.
%   The returned report and JSON/log files record the checks that actually ran.
%   A preview or numerical check is not a full encoded-video verification.
%
% QUICK START (after extracting the complete archive)
%   Set the MATLAB current folder to IECON2026_OPFa_H21_package, then use:
%     out = fullfile(getenv('LOCALAPPDATA'),'IECON2026_H21_check_01');
%     report = rebuild_iecon2026_opf_video('check',out);
%   For rendering, also supply 'PythonExecutable' with the absolute path to
%   the documented Python environment. FFmpeg/FFprobe can be on PATH or set
%   through 'FFmpegExecutable' and 'FFprobeExecutable'. See README.md for the
%   complete dependency list and full/preview examples. Use a new output folder
%   after changing source, mode, runtime paths or StrictReference; run_binding
%   prevents unrelated or differently configured output from being overwritten.
%
% REQUIRED ADJACENT INPUTS (keep their original filenames and exact bytes)
%   LUTs_data_OPF_H21_nt250.mat       Full stored current-coefficient LUT.
%   IECON2026_OPFa_H21_inputs.mat     Paired trajectory, normalized EMF and
%                                   reference context/provenance structures.
%   STEP8_Video_frame_samples.csv    The 600 original indices/metric checks.
%   IECON2026_OPFa_H21_speed_ramp_video.mp4  Delivered reference for comparison.
%   The MP4 is required even in 'check'. A source-only GitHub checkout lacks
%   the large inputs: download and extract the complete reproduction archive.
%
% SCOPE AND NUMERICAL QUALIFICATIONS
%   Fixed case: six phases; phase a open; one isolated neutral; five pole
%   pairs; odd current harmonics 1,3,...,21; zero cogging torque (Tcog = 0).
%   This file reconstructs the paper's stored reference currents. It does not
%   solve the offline LP/QP or simulate a current controller or acceleration.
%   The original optimization used 250 electrical angles; the displayed
%   cycles use 16,000 angles. Peak/ripple metrics remain sampled quantities.
%   The 600 frames follow the original sample order. Their 20 s playback is
%   not physical trajectory time, and no physical time vector is invented.
%   'StrictReference' defaults to true: exact reference arrays/runtime/render
%   identities are required in the relevant mode. False keeps input hashes,
%   model/support guards and numerical tolerances, but relaxes exact reference
%   comparisons. It does not correct the LUT's physical constraint overshoots.
%   A reproduction PASS is compatible with FAIL_CURRENT_AND_VOLTAGE: the
%   separate full-path continuous-angle audit found small current/voltage
%   excesses. No clipping, coefficient scaling or neutral projection hides
%   them. See README.md and the included Step-5 report for the quantified audit.
%
% SOURCE MAP
%   Main entry: guarded loading, trajectory selection, checks and orchestration.
%   load_model / interpolate_coefficients / reconstruct / normalized_emf:
%     the common scientific waveform calculation, with units and shapes below.
%   iecon2026_opf_cycle_metrics: metrics from those exact waveform arrays.
%   pkg_payload: frozen Python helpers and definition embedded in this file;
%     readable matching copies are supplied under rendering_support/.
%   SOURCE_GUIDE.md maps the files, functions, outputs and safe adaptation rules.
%   Local functions are implementation details; call the public entry above.

%% Options and package/output ownership
% Rendering tools are explicit executable paths, not commands evaluated by a
% shell. StrictReference controls reproduction checks; it never changes the
% stored operating points or the waveform formula. 'check' needs only base
% MATLAB with JVM; rendering additionally uses Windows .NET and Python.

% The embedded definition fixes scientific configuration, original input
% hashes, selected indices, reference metrics/pixels and helper identities.
% Absolute historical paths in adjacent provenance files are not read here.

% Bind each output folder to this exact entry file, mode, inputs and runtime
% paths. Even a comments-only source revision has a different file hash and
% must use a fresh output folder. Reuse is accepted only for the same binding.

%% Rendering preflight (preview/full only)
% Extract the embedded support only into the owned output folder. Its bytes
% must match the embedded hashes. Preflight checks the rendering environment
% before any expensive MATLAB cycle calculation begins.

%% Load the exact scientific case and retained trajectory
% The 1,443,053 original speed/torque samples are paired and kept in order.
% The selected contiguous prefix is indices 1:1,314,036, ending immediately
% before the first sample above 1500 r/min. Requested and used points are
% identical: no speed/torque sorting, smoothing, resampling or saturation.
% The approximately 849.87 r/min minimum is a retained original fluctuation.

%% Recompute progressive traces and select displayed samples
% Recalculate the left-column context with the SAME waveform/metric functions
% as the right-column cycles. Stored context values are comparison references,
% not an alternate source of live display metrics.

% floor(linspace(...)+0.5) selects 600 existing samples across the retained
% prefix; it does not generate interpolated operating points. Frame k starts
% at (k-1)/30 s of playback. Preview frame IDs are a subset of these same 600.
% The first displayed voltage/current excesses occur at frames 302/515;
% these are not exact continuous-path or optimization active-set transitions.

% One electrical cycle has uniform angles 2*pi/N,...,2*pi: exclude zero so
% the periodic endpoint is counted once. Even N supports exact half-cycle
% pairing. The renderer presents the cycle over 0-360 electrical degrees.

%% Reconstruct, measure and verify the common cycles
% W contains the actual cycle arrays; Q reduces those arrays into measurements.
% Each cycle is checked against 17 reference scalars and seven native-array
% SHA-256 fingerprints. A finer angular grid alone is not a continuous-angle
% peak certificate. The separate full-path audit is not rerun by this entry.

%     Send only the fields needed by the frozen renderer, without changing
%     their numbers. Batches of at most 25 avoid keeping all full cycles in
%     memory. Each exact transient MAT is removed only after its rendered
%     frame and scientific/artist comparisons pass; reviewed PNGs remain.

%% Write reports and verify that source inputs stayed unchanged
% Reports distinguish numerical reproduction from physical feasibility.
% Current/voltage overshoots are preserved; a faithful calculation therefore
% must retain the scientific failure flag rather than infer feasibility from
% a reproduction PASS. Only full mode encodes and checks the complete MP4.

% PKG_REBUILD_PLOT_CONTEXT Regenerate the progressive traces from native cycles.
% The 9,973 context source IDs are original trajectory samples and include
% the endpoint. Batches of 24 preserve the verified reduction order (important
% for bit-exact comparison). Arrays are [point, angle, phase/line]; reduction
% over dimension 2 gives one metric per operating point. All 19 context
% fields, including per-phase/per-line arrays, are checked after calculation.

% PKG_PYTHON Run the exact embedded driver invisibly, without a command shell.
% 'preflight' checks dependencies; 'batch' renders/checks supplied MATLAB
% cycles; 'encode' makes the MP4 and inspects all decoded frames. Read stdout
% and stderr concurrently to avoid a filled pipe blocking the child process.
% Logs remain in the owned output folder; a nonzero child exit is a failure.
% Append UTF-8 diagnostic text; onCleanup closes the exact file on errors too.

% Quote each Windows process argument literally. This helper is for the .NET
% launcher, not for PowerShell/cmd; embedded quotes and newlines are rejected.
% Resolve an absolute canonical path before ownership/containment comparisons.

% Use a separator boundary, so a sibling with a similar prefix is not accepted.
% Canonical Windows paths are compared without case sensitivity.

% Hash the native, real double values in MATLAB column-major order a(:).
% Little-endian ordering is enforced by the entry; dimensions are checked
% separately. This is a scientific-array fingerprint, not a MAT-file checksum.
% SHA-256 of exact bytes; Java signed-byte conversion preserves all bit values.
% Stream SHA-256 in 1 MiB blocks so large LUT/movie inputs need not be buffered.
% Write readable UTF-8 JSON; this function writes reports only, not inputs.
% Write frozen helper bytes in binary mode to preserve their hash/line endings.

% Private actions share one implementation: 'coefficients' selects retained
% trajectory IDs; 'cycle' reconstructs those points; 'point' accepts explicit
% speed/torque vectors for guarded diagnostics. The private 'load' action
% requires both folder and embedded definition D. These local functions are
% not standalone public scripts; use rebuild_iecon2026_opf_video to run them.

% LOAD_MODEL Assemble the fixed machine, full LUT, trajectory and EMF data.
% LUT IRe/IIm are stored as single, size [303 torque, 532 electrical frequency,
% 6 phases, 11 odd harmonics]. They are promoted to double without modifying
% the stored MAT. Coefficients have units A; speed is mechanical r/min; LUT
% frequency is fundamental electrical Hz; torque is Nm; angles are radians.
% Healthy phases b-f have independent coefficients, and phase a stays zero.

% Construct the stored feasible-vertex mask using the envelope and Tau_min.
% Some unsupported vertices contain finite zero-filled coefficients, so a
% finite-value check alone would accept invalid interpolation support.
% This mask checks the stored sampled optimization support; it is not a
% continuous-angle physical-constraint certificate.

% Paper VSD axis order: alpha, beta, x, y, 0+, 0-. Every resistance is 1.4 ohm;
% L diagonal is [0.012 0.012 0.0113 0.0113 0.0094 0.0094] H. The 0+ value is
% retained from source configuration; the paper specifies alpha-beta, x-y
% and 0- values. The single isolated neutral suppresses the ideal 0+ current.
% Use matrix left division to map VSD impedance back into the phase domain.
% Keep the complete model, including the open phase, when forming voltages.

% The source EMF is e'_k = e_k/omega_m in V/(mechanical rad/s), NOT voltage
% per electrical speed. Its 126-point periodic table includes both 0 and 2*pi
% for interp1; the reconstructed cycle itself contains only one endpoint.
% The 250-angle fingerprint verifies the exact processing used by the LUT.

% The 1e-5 A neutral guard detects inconsistent float32 coefficient data.
% It is a residual-consistency threshold, not permission to alter currents.
% The original small rounding residual is checked and never projected away.

% INTERPOLATE_COEFFICIENTS Guarded bilinear interpolation of every phase/harmonic.
% Accept paired vectors or broadcast one scalar; return coefficients shaped
% [point, phase, harmonic]. Use the same weights for IRe and IIm. Never share
% a healthy phase's coefficient vector with another phase in this fault case.

% With five pole pairs, f_e = 5*n/60. Below the first retained LUT column,
% only coefficient LOOKUP frequency is held at Faxis(1). Store factual and
% lookup separately: EMF and inductive voltage later use the actual n.
% This extrapolation rule is not a physical speed or torque saturation.

% An envelope pass does not ensure all four interpolation vertices are valid.
% Locate the bounding torque/frequency cell and its convex weights; inspect
% each nonzero-weight vertex below. At an exact breakpoint, a zero-weight
% outside vertex need not contribute, but no infeasible positive-weight
% vertex may be used. Unsupported points fail instead of being clipped.

% Express sum_k i_k in global cos(h*theta)/sin(h*theta) coefficients. For
% each harmonic the residual amplitude is hypot(cosine,sine); summing those
% amplitudes bounds the neutral residual for EVERY electrical angle, beyond
% the sampled cycle. Preserve the interpolated coefficients after this check.

% RECONSTRUCT Create the one common cycle at fixed speed and torque.
% Waveforms are [point, angle, phase] or [point, angle, line]; torque is
% [point, angle]. theta is rotor electrical angle in radians. Phase numbering
% 1:6 is a:f and phi_k = (k-1)*pi/3, exactly as in the paper.

% Paper current convention (IIm is the sine coefficient, with this sign):
%   i_k(theta) = sum_h [IRe(k,h)*cos(h*(theta-phi_k))
%                    + IIm(k,h)*sin(h*(theta-phi_k))], h = 1,3,...,21.
% Differentiate the harmonic series analytically in electrical angle; this
% avoids finite-difference errors in inductive voltage. At fixed operating
% point, di/dt = omega_e*di/dtheta. Derivatives of changing LUT coefficients
% during a physical acceleration are outside this quasi-steady calculation.

% Use ACTUAL mechanical speed for e_k = omega_m*e'_k, and actual electrical
% speed omega_e = 5*omega_m for the inductive term. This remains true when
% coefficients were looked up at the first LUT column. Phase a's induced EMF
% is retained even though its current is exactly zero.

% From the paper's D*v = R*D*i + L*d(D*i)/dt + D*e:
%   v = Rphase*i + Lphase*(omega_e*di/dtheta) + e.
% The common-mode voltage reference is immaterial to the constrained terminal
% differences. G_prime then forms every healthy-terminal line voltage v'_r.

% Paper nomenclature: v'_r is component r of v' = G_prime*v. In this open-phase
% case use all ten pairs bc,bd,be,bf,cd,ce,cf,de,df,ef in that order. Opposite-
% phase pairs alone, sufficient in the balanced healthy example, miss peaks.

% Torque follows the paper's T = sum_k e'_k*i_k + Tcog. Here Tcog = 0, so
% the normalized EMF can be used directly and the result is in Nm. Do not
% multiply this expression by mechanical speed or the pole-pair count again.

% NORMALIZED_EMF Match the LUT's periodic-linear, half-wave EMF processing.
% Phase-shift queries with the same theta-phi_k convention as the currents.
% Half-wave symmetry is e'(theta+pi) = -e'(theta), consistent with odd current
% harmonics and with limiting both positive and negative waveform peaks.

% For an even, half-cycle-paired grid, construct the second half as EXACTLY
% the negative of the first: 0.5*(raw(theta)-raw(theta+pi)). For other query
% grids evaluate the pi-shifted partner explicitly. Preserve raw and used
% EMF separately so the processing remains observable in the waveform struct.

% The private default reproduces the original 250-angle LUT convention.
% The public entry explicitly overrides it with 16,000 angles for the video.

% Indices address the original retained contiguous prefix, not a resampled
% or sorted trajectory. Preserve the original speed/torque pairing exactly.
% Reject unrelated model structs before applying this fixed-case engine.

% Named scientific failures make unsupported interpolation distinguishable
% from missing inputs and other calculation failures.

edits.text:
% Mean torque = arithmetic mean of the uniform complete cycle; tau is its
% maximum-minus-minimum torque, not RMS ripple or peak-to-mean deviation.
% Peak current is max over angle AND healthy phase of abs(i_k). Retain the
% phase and angle attaining each peak so plotted brackets can be checked.

% Each phase gets its own RMS = sqrt(mean(i_k^2)); unbalanced b-f currents
% cannot be represented by one shared RMS value. Physical SCL in watts is
% Rs*sum_k RMS_k^2 (phase a contributes zero). normalized_copper_loss_A2 is
% the current-squared quantity before multiplication by Rs, not loss in W.

% v_pk = max over electrical angle and ALL TEN r of abs(v'_r). The paper's
% v'_r labels the waveform, while v_pk labels its scalar peak measurement.

% For the full odd-harmonic series, per-phase mean(i_k^2) equals
% 0.5*sum_h(IRe_kh^2 + IIm_kh^2) on a sufficient uniform grid. This diagnostic
% can detect inconsistent waveform/coefficient scaling or phase-RMS reductions.
% The nt>=45 requirement prevents aliasing of squared H21 and rotating-frame
% fundamental currents; it does not guarantee accurate continuous peaks.

% Apply the documented negative-Park display convention to the complete
% alpha/beta waveforms. In this unbalanced case, balanced single-coefficient
% shortcuts would lose contributions from independent phases/harmonics.
% id1_A/iq1_A are cycle means of these instantaneous vectors; the retained
% left panels show those means even though 'cycle mean' is omitted visually.
% Keep metric-consistency errors separate from waveform/interpolation errors.

% PKG_PAYLOAD Decode frozen support so the MATLAB entry remains self-contained.
% The long strings below are BASE64 SOURCE, not numerical current/EMF data.
% 'renderer': exact_layout.py, fixed layout/colours/fonts and artist checks.
% 'inspector': exact_inspector.py, probe/decode/frame-order/fidelity checks.
% 'driver': package_driver.py, preflight/render/encode orchestration.
% 'definition': immutable scientific/runtime/input and gold-reference metadata.
% Readable copies of the three Python sources are in rendering_support/.
% The readable IECON2026_OPFa_H21_package.json also holds runtime_definition.
% The entry executes THESE embedded bytes; editing a readable copy alone
% does not change the movie. A derivative that changes a payload must also
% update its identity and reference checks, then verify and label the result.
% The encoded blocks are intentionally kept byte-exact for this release.
